full_prompt_en: A square, dramatic expressionist painting shows a looming older man striding through rubble beneath a turbulent blue and orange sky. The background recedes to a damaged row of pale buildings at the right, their roofline jagged against a streak of warm horizon light. Above, blue-green storm clouds twist through rusty red and gold bands, creating a restless diagonal sweep. The foreground man dominates the left and center. His cap, gaunt face, and deeply lined cheeks are seen from a low angle, making his head and shoulders appear huge. He wears a dark loose jacket over a muted shirt and brown trousers; one long arm reaches down toward the lower-left corner with an oversized hand, while the other bends into a clenched fist near the chest. His body leans forward in a forceful step over broken stones. Behind and below him on the left, smaller figures crouch or move among the rubble, their faces and garments partly obscured by his large silhouette. The rough ground is packed with pale gray rocks, splintered forms, and warm dust, leading toward the battered buildings. Every face, hand, and fold is exaggerated by hard angular highlights and deep creases, yet the paint remains energetic rather than mechanically outlined. Thick strokes and scratched details build skin, fabric, stone, and rushing cloud into a continuous agitated texture. Light breaks low from the right, casting orange across the horizon and edges of the ruins while cool teal shadow presses over the giant figure. The overall composition is tense and physically crowded, using distorted scale, thrusting diagonals, and clashing cool-warm light to convey struggle.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、戏剧性的表现主义绘画呈现一位身形逼近的年长男子，在翻腾的蓝橙色天空下跨过瓦砾。背景退向右侧一排受损的浅色建筑，锯齿状屋顶线立在一条暖色地平线光前。上方，蓝绿色风暴云在铁锈红和金色带之间扭动，形成不安定的斜向扫势。前景男子支配左侧与中央。低视角仰望他的帽子、消瘦面孔和深刻脸纹，使头肩显得巨大。他穿宽松深色外套、暗色衬衫和棕色长裤；一只长手臂伸向左下角，过大的手垂在那里，另一只手则在胸前弯成拳头。身体向前倾，正有力跨过碎石。他身后更低的左侧，较小的人物在瓦砾间蹲伏或移动，脸和衣服部分被巨大剪影遮住。粗糙地面塞满浅灰岩石、碎裂形体和暖色灰尘，通向受损的建筑。每张脸、每只手和每道衣褶都被坚硬的棱角亮部与深皱纹夸张，却仍保有富动势的颜料，而非机械描边。厚笔触和刮划细节把皮肤、布料、石头和奔涌的云连成持续躁动的肌理。光从右侧低处破出，把橙色投向地平线和废墟边缘，冷青蓝阴影则压在巨大的前景人物身上。整体构图紧张且在身体上显得拥挤，以扭曲尺度、向前冲的斜线和冷暖光冲撞传达挣扎。
style_prompt_en: The expressionist painting exaggerates scale and anatomy through thrusting diagonals, angular highlights, and deep incised shadow. Blue-green, charcoal, rust, ocher, and pale stone colors clash in large restless fields. Thick brush marks and scratched details make surfaces rough and physical, with creases and ridges emphasized rather than smoothed away. A large near mass presses against the frame while smaller forms recede sharply, creating unease and urgency. Light breaks from one low side, warming distant edges as cool shadow bears down on the foreground. The sky and ground share similar turbulent strokes, unifying the whole frame in motion. The overall effect is muscular and anxious, with distorted perspective and material intensity doing the emotional work.
style_prompt_zh: 表现主义绘画用前冲的斜线、棱角亮部和深刻阴影夸张尺度与形体。蓝绿、炭黑、铁锈色、赭黄和浅石色在大片不安定色域中相撞。厚笔痕和刮划细节使表面粗糙而有实体感，皱褶与凸脊被强调，而非磨平。巨大的近处体块挤向画框，较小形体急剧退远，制造不安与迫切。光从一侧低处破出，使远处边缘变暖，冷影却压住前景。天空与地面共享相似的翻腾笔触，让全幅统一在运动中。整体效果强健而焦虑，扭曲透视与材料力度承担情绪。
theme_en: A looming older man striding through rubble beneath a turbulent sky
theme_zh: 一位身形逼近的年长男子在翻腾天空下跨过瓦砾
name: Peter Howson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
